title: EWOH Canonical Maintenance Condition Model
description: EWOH 统一维护状态契约（ADR-010，Phase 6 NO-05a）。subjectEntityId 引用规范身份（ADR-006）；severity 走 Canonical Risk 阶梯（ADR-007）；生命周期 detected→acknowledged→work_order_created→resolved→closed（resolved 前必须 work_order_created；closed 终态）；逾期判定 overdue（dueAt < now 且未 resolved/closed）机器可执行，供调度维护状态输入。

transition.const: detected→acknowledged→work_order_created→resolved→closed；resolved 前必须 work_order_created；closed 终态；其余非法转移拒绝

overdue.const: dueAt < now 且 status ∉ {resolved, closed} → overdue=true（机器可执行）

canonicalRefs.const: subjectEntityId 必须是规范身份（kind:value，ADR-006），否则拒绝

severityContract.const: severity 走 Canonical Risk 阶梯（critical/high/medium/low，legacy L1-L3 映射），否则拒绝

rules.transition: detected→acknowledged→work_order_created→resolved→closed；resolved 前必须 work_order_created；closed 终态；其余非法转移拒绝
rules.overdue: dueAt < now 且 status ∉ {resolved, closed} → overdue=true（机器可执行）
rules.canonicalRefs: subjectEntityId 必须是规范身份（kind:value，ADR-006），否则拒绝
rules.severityContract: severity 走 Canonical Risk 阶梯（critical/high/medium/low，legacy L1-L3 映射），否则拒绝
